review_scope: Existing MASTER V3 six stills, actual v001 ten-thumbnail contact sheet, prior preflight stills and three Scene1/2 extracted frames; one new actual v001 15-second still. No new GL render, full movie decode, realtime playback, direct listening or physical-phone test in this review.

automation.time_comparison_limit: Different geography, camera and choreography. Same clock time is not the same pose or a pixel-equivalence experiment. The actual 0.5-second frame is not directly viewed; actual 14 seconds complements 15 seconds for the shifted HERO peak.

retained_visual_components.depth_atmosphere_and_3d_entity: observed_and_recorded; continuous parallax and all occlusion not certified
retained_visual_components.original_aircraft_geometry: retained; smaller upper-view HERO weakens perceived detail

quality_concerns.evidence: actual_v001_15_00.png vs comparison_v3_15.00.png; actual contact at 14 seconds
quality_concerns.finding: At 15 seconds, aircraft is smaller and upper-view on brighter land; fuselage/intake/shadow separation is weaker than baseline. New HERO peak is earlier, so not a pose-matched numerical regression.
quality_concerns.action: Judge whole corrected playback; camera/common lighting/exposure before adding effects.

quality_concerns.finding: Brighter Europe/day and region emphasis improve geographic readout but feel more like an explanatory map than baseline night shots.
quality_concerns.action: Check day/night rhythm in full playback; not proof of a planar-renderer regression.

quality_concerns.evidence: completed Scene 1/2 audits and previously extracted boundary stills
quality_concerns.finding: No clear visible kink in the tiny aircraft from still pairs.
quality_concerns.action: Inspect the real-time seam at 4 seconds; do not mandate GPU rerender from angle alone.

rerender_appraisal.note: Static observations do not justify unconditional reuse or final approval. Corrected v002 QC and full playback remain required.

limits: Contact sheet is 10 visual samples, not 600 individually inspected frames.
No full realtime playback, physical phone, direct listening or audience-retention experiment.
Preflight frames remain preflight evidence; final r02 title hold near 20 seconds is not covered by the actual 19-second contact.
No local original target image or pixel comparison; photoreal city closeups/landmarks/live-action aircraft clip not implemented.
Surface uses 8K texture/bump, not actual DEM/buildings; clouds, atmosphere and reflection remain approximations.
Source SHA preservation is provenance, not equality of camera/uniform inputs or rendered RGB.
